note: The words on the Prefab Test floor's menu board (commons/artifacts/prefab_test/menu_board.gd). Every line here was read from the code on 2026-11-22: the board's tabs from commons/player/select_board.gd (TABS), the buttons from commons/void/game.gd (_right_button, _left_button, _unhandled_key_input) and commons/player/inventory_desktop.gd, the belt from commons/artifacts/prefab_belt/prefab_belt.gd. The four badge notes are NOT written here: the board reads them from commons/data/badges/coins.json (verbs), so they change with the coins. If a button changes in the code, change the line here.
title: HOW THE MENU WORKS
subtitle: Prefab Test: a floor to try the hand on

notes.title: OPEN THE BOARD
lines: Headset: right A, or left Y.
Desktop: I. M pauses.
The same button closes it.

notes.title: ITS TABS
lines: HAND what you hold. KNOBS its settings.
PLACED what you have put down.
PREFABS, BADGES, FLOORS, VOICE, PAUSE, KEYS.

notes.title: CHOOSE A THING
lines: Headset: click the left stick. Each click, the next thing.
Desktop: Tab. Shift+Tab goes back.
Headset, right B: the last thing again.

notes.title: PLACE IT
lines: Aim at the floor, or at a thing already placed.
Headset: trigger. Desktop: F.
Take it back: grip. Desktop: X.

notes.title: THE BELT
lines: Four trays of the prefab timeline.
STEP keys move one tray. The lever rolls.
Take a thing off its tray: it is yours.
A closed box names the floor that opens it.

notes.title: THIS FLOOR
lines: Two taped areas: step over the tape, the pile clears.
Nothing placed here is kept.
The white block stops nobody: walk in under the pagoda.
Two doors by the arrival: on to Melencolia, back to Portals.

badges_note: Until its coin is yours you can place and take back. The coins stand on the floors after Melencolia.
